description: TimescaleDB skips tuning-file partitioning and clustering (benchbox/platforms/timescaledb.py:50-51: execution_partitioning_supported = False, post_load_index_cluster_supported = False). Its native layout controls are reachable only through CLI flags: --timescale-chunk-interval and --timescale-compression (timescaledb.py:73-97). Map the tuning file onto them: a date partition column becomes the hypertable time column, sort columns become compress_orderby, and segment columns become compress_segmentby. CLUSTER on a hypertable succeeded in the timescale/timescaledb:latest-pg17 image during the #3092 verification, so enabling the PostgreSQL index + CLUSTER step for TimescaleDB is also an option. Record each request in the ledger with catalog evidence (timescaledb_information views).
